name: imf_get_dataflows
description:
List the dataflows the IMF publishes for one database code, from the IMF SDMX JSON data service (dataservices.imf.org, no API key).
Returns: database, dataflows (id, name) and count; on failure an error and note instead.
Inputs (* required): database* (IFS, DOT, BOP, GFSR, FSI, WEO, GFSMAB, CDIS, CPIS, WHDREO; the schema's default is IFS).
Discover database codes with imf_get_databases; fetch values with imf_get_data.
Example: {"database": "IFS"}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Explore available indicators and dataflows within IMF databases.
